title: [P2.10a-pre-2] Bearer-admitted HUMAN at Gate 1 stage E, hardened per ruling (b): kind-split, one-shot burn with TTL, seam-local widening
description:
FILED per the HUMAN-RATIFIED ruling on the Gate 1 fork (comment-07a17d40 on task-db4aeeaf, governor-0af24e35 16:26Z, operator chose (b)). Sequenced AFTER task-db4aeeaf30524fef8acfc87786779106 (the HUMAN principal mint at the approved pairing claim) and BEFORE parent task-db1a8566958f416b92105cc2c7e51591 step 2 clause (c) (stage-E reachability). Landing this before db4aeeaf would admit bearers with no principal to key on — a live-authority hole — so the ordering is a safety constraint, gated in DoD 1.

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD 5834b676: Gate 1 stage E is `sessions.authenticate(input.authentication)` (apps/daemon/src/product-contract/product-contract-gate-1-command.ts:198; resolver half :59), i.e. the SessionAuthority cryptographic protocol — `readPresentedAuthentication` (identity/session-authority-protocol.ts:275) demands the AUTH_KEYS block incl. clientKeyId and a single-use signed `proof` (readSessionProof :220). A paired operator holds a BEARER credential (identity/session-handshake.ts) authenticated everywhere else by the OLD authenticator `createSessionAuthenticator(...).authenticate(credential)` (session-authenticator.ts:109; callers http-command-ingress.ts:94, mcp-dispatch-port.ts:170, mcp-http-session-port.ts:69), whose working principalId IS the session id (:139). After db4aeeaf, that session id is ALSO a SessionAuthority principal with kind HUMAN (readPrincipalRecord, session-authority-store.ts:286). Nothing lets a bearer reach stage E: `git grep -n 'createSessionAuthenticator\|readPrincipalRecord' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/product-contract/` EXIT 1.

DELIVER (ruling conditions 1-3 verbatim as DoD): stage E accepts EITHER the existing signed proof OR a bearer credential, at the stage-E seam ONLY; bearer admission only for a principal whose SessionAuthority record is kind HUMAN on the same session id (AGENT/SYSTEM/absent refuse with exact code+layer); one-shot burn per Gate 1 authentication bound to a fresh request identity with TTL — compose `observeReplayMarker` (session-authority-store.ts:358, burns a replay digest at expected version 0) with a digest from `sessionReplayDigest` (session-authority-protocol.ts) over (sessionId, requestId, requestDigest); replay refuses with exact code+layer; readPresentedAuthentication byte-identical.

CONSUMER: task-db1a8566 step 2(c). FOLLOW-UP (ruling condition 4): option (a) browser client-key pairing ingress is filed as the hardening row beside this one.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, in a row comment with `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, every grep unpiped with its own exit code plus a positive control. SAFETY ORDER: task-db4aeeaf30524fef8acfc87786779106 is DONE on disk AND `git grep -n 'createPrincipal(' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/identity/session-handshake.ts` EXIT 0 (the HUMAN mint is in HEAD) — relaxing this before db4aeeaf admits bearers with no kind-bearing principal to key on; report blocked if unmet. Gap still open: `git grep -n -E 'createSessionAuthenticator|readPrincipalRecord|BEARER' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/product-contract/` EXIT 1 (EXIT 0 = someone widened stage E: adopt/verify/report duplicate). Ruling comment-07a17d40 re-read and its four conditions quoted in the record. Porcelain clean on product-contract-gate-1-command.ts and its tests; live ownership scan for those paths.

STAGE E ACCEPTS A BEARER, PRODUCTION-PROVEN: a session minted by a REAL pairing (POST /session/pair/request -> operator approval -> claim, the db4aeeaf listener arm's route) presents its bearer credential to Gate 1 through the production command (`sessions.authenticate` OR the widened stage-E function it calls) and authenticates with `facts.principalKind === "HUMAN"` and `facts.principalId === <session id>`; the existing signed-proof path authenticates exactly as before (its existing arms pass unedited). The bearer branch is reached ONLY from stage E's seam: `git grep -l` for the new bearer-admission symbol lists exactly the gate-1 module(s) and their tests — no second admission path.

KIND-SPLIT (ruling condition 1): a bearer whose session id has NO SessionAuthority principal, or whose principal is kind AGENT or SYSTEM (seed via the production `createPrincipal` API in the test, never a fixture record), is REFUSED at stage E with an exact stable code AND layer, asserted per kind in separate arms; the refusal is distinguishable from the signed-proof path's AUTHENTICATION_FAILED so the divergence fixture proves the bearer branch answered.

ONE-SHOT BURN WITH TTL (ruling condition 2), written and drilled: each bearer authentication at Gate 1 burns a replay digest derived from (sessionId, requestId, requestDigest) via `observeReplayMarker` (session-authority-store.ts:358) at expected version 0; replaying the SAME bearer authentication (same requestId/requestDigest) is REFUSED with an exact code+layer; a fresh requestId succeeds; a presentation past the TTL is refused with its own code; TTL and burn semantics are documented at the seam. Drill: delete the burn -> the replay arm reds; loosen the TTL by one unit -> the TTL arm reds.

SEAM-LOCAL (ruling condition 3): `readPresentedAuthentication` and `readSessionProof` in session-authority-protocol.ts are byte-identical (`git diff --stat HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/identity/session-authority-protocol.ts` EMPTY at the delivered commit); session-authority.ts / session-authority-store.ts are composed, not edited; the widening lives in the product-contract gate-1 module(s) only, each <= 250 lines (split before 400, `.js` bridge for any new module).

Mutation drills, one degree of freedom each, restores proven by SHA256 vs %TEMP% backups (files are uncommitted at drill time): (D1) admit any principal kind -> kind-split arms red; (D2) skip the principal lookup -> the absent-principal arm reds; (D3) delete the burn -> replay arm reds; (D4) route the bearer check before the signed-proof path so a signed proof is treated as a bearer -> the existing signed-proof arms red. A green drill is a finding, never a pass.

Gates standalone, foreground, unpiped, exit 0 with nonzero counts quoted: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo); focused daemon suites from apps/daemon (`pnpm exec vitest run <gate-1 tests> src/identity/session-authority.test.ts src/identity/session-handshake.test.ts src/http/http-listener-pairing-principal.test.ts`) with `Test Files N passed`; `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` path-attributed with foreign red disclosed verbatim. Explicit-pathspec commit; completion comment names task-db1a8566958f416b92105cc2c7e51591 as consumer and the option-(a) hardening row as the end-state follow-up, and states the delivered claim: 'a paired human authenticates at Gate 1 stage E as HUMAN by bearer, one-shot with TTL; every other kind refuses'.
taskRails: Ruling comment-07a17d40 is binding: bearer admission ONLY for HUMAN principals minted by an approved pairing claim on the same session id; AGENT/SYSTEM bearers refuse exactly as today.

The replay story is written AND drilled: one-shot burn per Gate 1 authentication, bound to a fresh request identity with TTL, composed from observeReplayMarker/sessionReplayDigest — never a second replay ledger, never an in-memory set.
The widening lives at stage E's seam only; readPresentedAuthentication and the key-holding transport path are untouched; session-authority*.ts are composed, never edited.
Never derive principal kind from the request, a header, a capability list or the bearer string — only from the SessionAuthority principal record keyed on the authenticated session id.
Sequenced after task-db4aeeaf (safety: no admission without a kind-bearing principal); consumer task-db1a8566 step 2(c). Preserve foreign WIP; explicit-pathspec commits only.
Fail closed with exact code+layer per refusal; TDD red-first on the production command; <=250 lines per production source.

comments.author: architect-c1a63707
comments.content:
PLAN-TIME MEASUREMENT + THREE AUTHOR CLARIFICATIONS (architect-c1a63707, HEAD 5834b676, 2026-08-29). The DoD field has no editing tool; this comment binds worker and QA.

MEASURED: stage E = product-contract-gate-1-command.ts:198 inside `createProductContractGate1Authority({ projectId, sessions })` (:178-208); the runner (:290) is dispatched at daemon-command-registry.ts:231 inside a handler that already holds the INGRESS-AUTHENTICATED `principal` (:160; paired sessions authenticate with principalId === sessionId, session-authenticator.ts:139). payload.authentication is opaque at decode. Burn primitive: observeReplayMarker(store, {replayDigest, principalId, decidedAt}) (session-authority-store.ts:358). TTL constants exported at session-authority-contracts.ts:20-21. Gap grep EXIT 1; porcelain clean; no non-terminal row edits the gate-1 files.

CLARIFICATION 1 — THE BEARER CREDENTIAL NEVER ENTERS THE PAYLOAD. Gate 1's request bytes are persisted as requestBytes in the decision ledger; a credential there would be a durable secret. The design: payload.authentication carries a bearer PRESENTATION `{ issuedAt, kind: "BEARER", requestId, requestDigest }` (pointers only, bound to the command id and subject digest exactly like the signed path's stage D), and the registry threads a SERVER-ASSEMBLED witness `{ sessionId: principal.principalId }` from its own arguments — the HumanReviewWitness pattern (:200). DoD-2's "presents its bearer credential to Gate 1" is satisfied by presenting it to the INGRESS (x-moe-session-credential), which is the only place a bearer is ever read.

CLARIFICATION 2 — REPLAY DIGEST. DoD-4 says "via observeReplayMarker/sessionReplayDigest". sessionReplayDigest's exact roster is {sessionId, generation, clientKeyId, nonce} — a bearer has no clientKeyId or generation. The BURN goes through observeReplayMarker (the shared SessionAuthorityReplayObserved ledger at expected version 0); the DIGEST is domain-separated: sha256("moe/product-contract/gate-1/bearer-replay/v1" \0 sessionId \0 requestId \0 requestDigest). One-shot semantics are the ledger's, not a new mechanism.

CLARIFICATION 3 — THE LOCAL OPERATOR CREDENTIAL. It authenticates at the ingress as the configured operator principal, which has NO SessionAuthority principal record (db4aeeaf mints only from approved pairing claims). At Gate 1 by bearer it therefore refuses PRINCIPAL_ABSENT — exactly ruling condition 1 ("ONLY ... minted from an APPROVED PAIRING CLAIM"). T3 pins this; do not "fix" it.

Refusals travel through the gate-1 module's existing `upstream(code, layer)` wrapper, so the closed PRODUCT_CONTRACT_GATE_1 refusal roster is unchanged; the bearer module owns its own seven-code roster under layer DAEMON_GATE_1_BEARER (module-private constant, not a column-zero `*_LAYER` export — boundary-roster scanner). Consumer: task-db1a8566 step 2(c) (amend-3 names this row); follow-up: task-2f554e29 (option (a)).
